name: history-bound-commit-tree
goal: Keep per-tree reads within the shared immutable blob cache bound during history reconstruction.

evidence: The per-tree cache retains every resolved blob even when the shared cache refuses blobs larger than its 64 MiB limit; the guarded history probe exceeded 5 GiB after 18 revisions.
The existing read/populated method case checks reuse across trees but never checks oversized blobs or eviction; extend that same case using real Git reads.
Red 5923c59fe36f at 752276fac4 proves oversized blob text is retained by the per-tree cache.
Commit e9ca66832d removes completed requests from the per-tree map while retaining bounded shared caching.
Green 41250f40a07d passes the unchanged read case in the same environment.
